policy.scope: isolated full-person visible appearance including clothes, worn bags and carried items
policy.external_occlusion: exclude externally occluded body or included accessory, without severity exceptions
policy.truncation: exclude raw-image truncation or foreground on the raw image boundary
policy.self_occlusion: retain natural self-occlusion; do not synthesize hidden anatomy
policy.pixel_size: record true raw pixel height; no score-dependent size threshold
policy.selection: all 100 remain fixed; no replacements for unavailable reference or method
policy.evidence: source-only review before batch scoring; predictions never choose mask, ROI or qualification
